name: statemachine-visualizer
description: Workspace-wide file dependency graph for C/C++ projects: black-box file mesh with expand-to-functions, plus state machine diagram extraction.

commands.title: C/C++ Dependency Graph: Open Workspace Map
C/C++ Dependency Graph: View State Machine for File
State Machines: Export Diagram via Graphviz (.dot/.svg)

explorer/context.when: resourceExtname == '.c' || resourceExtname == '.cpp' || resourceExtname == '.h' || resourceExtname == '.hpp' || resourceExtname == '.cc' || resourceExtname == '.cxx' || resourceExtname == '.hxx'

editor/title/context.when: resourceExtname == '.c' || resourceExtname == '.cpp' || resourceExtname == '.h' || resourceExtname == '.hpp' || resourceExtname == '.cc' || resourceExtname == '.cxx' || resourceExtname == '.hxx'

statemachineVisualizer.scan.include.description: Glob patterns for files to scan for state machines.

statemachineVisualizer.scan.exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from scanning.

enumDescriptions: Pure regex/heuristic parsing. No external dependencies, works immediately.
Heuristic parsing plus a ctags symbol index for more accurate cross-file caller/callee resolution in the I/O black-box view.
statemachineVisualizer.parsing.mode.description: How source files are analyzed. Heuristic mode needs no external tools. Other modes are opt-in and require the matching tool path below to be set.

statemachineVisualizer.tools.ctagsPath.description: Optional. Path to a universal-ctags executable. If set, enables 'ctags-enhanced' parsing mode for better cross-file symbol resolution (who calls this function from other files). Not required for default heuristic mode.

statemachineVisualizer.tools.cscopePath.description: Optional. Path to a cscope executable. If set, used to enrich the black-box I/O view with workspace-wide caller/callee information beyond the current file. Not required for default heuristic mode.

statemachineVisualizer.tools.clangPath.description: Optional, reserved for future use. Path to clang/libclang for full AST-based semantic parsing instead of heuristics. Leave blank unless you specifically need clang-accurate parsing of complex macros/templates.

statemachineVisualizer.tools.graphvizPat.description: Optional. Path to the Graphviz 'dot' executable. If set, enables exporting the state diagram as a .dot/.svg file via Graphviz layout instead of the built-in webview renderer. Not required to use the extension.
